name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio advisor (health, rebalancing, strategy review), and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation and research engine. Skills: /evaluate-stock (Bear/Base/Bull DCF projections with analyticsLog), /research-stock (qualitative sweep with Class A/B/C/D change classification and decision gate before re-valuation).

plugins.name: portfolio-advisor
plugins.description: Investment portfolio advisor suite. Skills: /review-portfolio (quick health check — drift monitor, pillar conviction audit, thesis formula score), /strategic-review (adversarial thesis challenger with valuation-grounded formula improvement proposals), /rebalance (valuation-gated trade optimizer — never buys SELL-rated holdings to restore drift), /calibrate-targets (interactive target-weight session), /update-portfolio-targets (apply formula changes).

plugins.name: toolkit-manager
plugins.description: Orchestrator for the Investment Screener suite. Handles server startup (/start-screener) and Questrade API token seeding (/setup-questrade).

plugins.name: tradingview
plugins.description: TradingView Desktop integration for real-time prices, DCF price alerts, and chart snapshots. Skills: /tv-price-refresh (live quotes for all positions via TradingView Premium, falls back to yfinance), /tv-alert-sync (create TradingView price alerts at DCF bear/base/bull targets), /tv-snapshot TICKER (capture chart screenshot). Requires TradingView Desktop running with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
